question: After the pacing defect is fixed, should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either queue behavior, but the durable operator tradeoff between future recoverability and a clear terminal failed state needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing repair and exact-head validation if maintainers want no-adapter ambiguous rows to stay recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a companion doctor, UI, or API surface before allowing ambiguous entries to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing repair and exact-head validation if maintainers want no-adapter ambiguous rows to stay recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged recent outbound recovery PRs and the decision crosses core queue semantics, operator visibility, and message-delivery behavior.
